Done — added all three QoL updates in `scripts/test/basic_test/test_matching_velo_nonconvex.py`.

### What I changed

- Added arrowhead on robot heading indicator  
  - Kept the center-to-tip line.
  - Added a small arrow tip (`-|>`) so orientation is easier to read.

- Improved readability of robot snapshots  
  - Slightly increased snapshot opacity.
  - Highlighted the robot at `t=0` with a distinct color (`goldenrod`) plus dashed ring emphasis.

- Added `--non_mirror` flag  
  - When enabled, only the forward diff-drive solution is computed/plotted.
  - Backward panel is replaced with a note that mirror mode is disabled.
  - Error plot and command plot also omit backward traces when `--non_mirror` is set.

### Usage

- Silent + non-mirror example:
  - `python3 scripts/test/basic_test/test_matching_velo_nonconvex.py --shape meteor --omega 0.3 --duration 5 --save meteor_arc_nonmirror.png --silent --non_mirror`

### Quick verification

- I ran the command above and confirmed it saved:
  - `/tmp/matching_velo/meteor_arc_nonmirror.png`

There is still that intermittent post-run native `malloc_consolidate` abort in this environment, but the figure is saved successfully before it happens.
